description: This file provides functions for subscribing and unsubscribing to real-time updates on specific database tables ('transactions' and 'alerts') using Supabase's Realtime Channels. It manages channels, handles events, and exposes a public interface for real-time data synchronization related to user transactions and alerts.

methods.name: subscribeToTransactionsRealtime
methods.description: Subscribes to real-time changes on the 'transactions' table for a specific user, returning a channel object or an error.

methods.name: subscribeToAlertsRealtime
methods.description: Subscribes to real-time changes on the 'alerts' table for a specific user, returning a channel object or an error.

methods.name: unsubscribeRealtimeChannel
methods.description: Unsubscribes and removes a given real-time channel.
